name: acos
expr: y = acos(x); yc = acos(2); yn = acos(-2); ya = acos(xo);
comment: Sig: y = acos(x). Element-wise inverse-trig (libm-backed). For a REAL argument outside [-1,1] the result is complex and the whole array is promoted (fixed 2026-06-05): acos(2)=0+i*acosh(2)=0+1.31696i; acos(-2)=pi-i*acosh(2)=3.14159-1.31696i; acos([0.5 2 -3]) mixes a real element with complex ones. Computed via acosh because std::acos's complex branch cut flips the imaginary sign vs MATLAB on [1,inf). Spec-extension batch 2026-05-09 — fingerprint covers domain edges + a few interior points. verified bit-identical to MATLAB R2025b (tol=1e-12 covers libm vs Intel-SVML differences).
